**Forkcast 2.0: a free calorie and nutrition tracker for Android. Your food log stays on your phone.**

- **Log a meal your way:** scan a barcode, search Open Food Facts (and USDA FoodData Central, with a free key), read a nutrition label with the camera, or enter it by hand.
- **Photo or sentence, with AI if you want it:** connect your own AI service and Forkcast shows an estimate with a likely range, which you review and adjust. AI is optional.
- **A budget that learns:** your daily budget starts from your goal and adjusts to the calories you actually burn, worked out from your weight trend.
- **Trends:** calories against your budget, weight trend and goal date, macros, nutrients and a weekly check-in.
- **Water and Health Connect:** one tap for your usual glass or bottle; weight, steps and workouts come in from your other apps, and your food and water go out.
- **Your backups, your place:** one encrypted file you save wherever you want, and automatic backups to a folder you choose.
- **Private by design:** no account, no ads, no tracking, and no server of ours. Forkcast only talks to the services you set up.
- **In English and Brazilian Portuguese.**

New here? [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/djemes/forkcast/blob/main/INSTALL.md) walks you through installing it. Forkcast needs Android 10 or newer.

Forkcast gives estimates, not medical advice.
